verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a SaaS security and compliance platform that also ships a device agent, so the axis applies. The pack contains no documented control for disabling product telemetry or usage tracking. The `oneleet-ignore=true` AWS tag and deleting the AWS role are adjacent data-ingestion and access controls, not telemetry opt-outs, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
